mutations.label: R1 the reuse branch is inverted: a twin that EXISTS gets a clone filed anyway, and when none exists `task` becomes None. Every string the test file asserts on survives verbatim, so this is a pure behaviour change under an unchanged source text

R2 the status filter is inverted, so a `completed`/`cancelled` twin SUPPRESSES the refile and an open one does not -- exactly what the docstring says must not happen (1156 duplicated titles ended completed; a check that fails again must still file). `test_a_completed_twin_does_not_suppress_a_refile` only asserts the WORD is absent

R3 the prefix match becomes an exact match. Titles now carry the #1202ss instance suffix, so no open twin is ever found and r130's 13 clones come back -- the code's own comment says the prefix is `Kept ... so #794's open-task lookup (prefix, below) still match`
